verdict.rationale: First-party docs say llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal and runs on macOS across most CPU architectures, so Metal-accelerated inference on Apple Silicon is a documented capability. ARM-specific optimizations are only implied by the general CPU-architecture portability claim, and there is no hands-on Apple Silicon performance evidence. missing for 10: explicit documentation of native ARM/Apple Silicon CPU optimizations, Metal setup and usage details, independent or hands-on Apple Silicon performance corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, and Vulkan.
runs locally on most operating systems and CPU architectures, with no installation
Runs on a wide range of operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux, BSD, etc.), without installation or setup.
